text: On the authority of Abu Al-Zubair that he heard a peacock saying: We told Ibn Abbas - may God be pleased with him - about squatting on the feet, and he said: It is the Sunnah. So we said to him: We see it as an act of injustice towards the man, and Ibn Abbas said: Rather, it is the Sunnah of your Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace.
